welcome.title: Server setup and management
welcome.description:
Check Debian, suggest a port, generate credentials and test REALITY targets.
Review the plan before installing or changing the server.

review.title: Deployment plan

review.credentials: UUID, keys, Short ID and path are generated automatically; existing credentials are preserved.
review.scope:
Installs the official stable Xray release, writes managed files and enables a systemd service.
Existing nodes only receive config changes. Firewall, SSH and BBR settings are not changed.

hint.address: The public IPv4 or hostname clients connect to. The detected exit address must also accept inbound connections.
hint.port: TCP 443 by default. A free alternative is suggested if occupied. Valid range: 1–65535.
hint.listen: 0.0.0.0 by default, listening on all IPv4 interfaces. This version supports IPv4 listeners only.
hint.target: Hostname or hostname:port; port defaults to 443. TLS 1.3 and HTTP/2 are tested before deployment.
hint.server_name: SNI hostname supported by the target certificate. Check this when changing the target.
hint.uuid: An automatically generated UUID. Reimport the node on all clients after changing it.
hint.private_key: Keep the generated X25519 private key by default. The public key is derived automatically; changes require client reimport.
hint.short_id: Generated automatically. Use 2–16 hexadecimal characters with an even length.
hint.path: Random by default, beginning with /. Clients must use exactly the same path.
hint.mode: Default: auto. Options: auto, stream-one, stream-up, packet-up.
hint.fingerprint: Default: chrome. Options: chrome, firefox, safari, edge, ios, android, random, randomized.
hint.log_level: Default: warning. Options: debug, info, warning, error, none.
